put.summary: Partially update an owned post (legacy PUT alias)
put.description:
Compatibility alias for PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}; retained so existing clients continue working. Despite PUT, this endpoint keeps the existing partial-update semantics and is not a full-resource replacement. New clients should use PATCH. Omitted scalar fields and relation arrays are preserved. Explicit relation arrays replace those relations; an empty array clears them. An empty JSON object is a no-op for an otherwise valid existing post. Existing content/media validation and author-only permissions are unchanged; this change introduces a canonical HTTP method without changing the update service.
No query parameters are read. Authenticated author only; deleted/missing post => 40401, another author => 42201. Empty final non-repost content without media, invalid visibility/language, invalid body/path, unusable attachments => 40001. Relationship arrays replace existing values when present; unknown keys and unsupported creation-only reference fields are ignored. Success data is complete serialized post, not a diff. Returning the updated post can also yield 40401 if it is no longer visible, or author lookup fails. Authentication accepts bearer token or access_token cookie according to auth middleware; all successful responses have meta=null (no pagination). Framework/Oracle/Redis failures can produce 5xx; source audit is not runtime acceptance. Feature schema changes are performed only by the explicit migration tool; request readiness checks are read-only.

AuditedModerationJsonValue.description: Any JSON value accepted by the existing input coercion/ignore paths; this is not an unspecified business response object.

AuditedModerationCoercedString.description: v2String: strings unchanged; JSON numbers/booleans converted using String(value); null, object and array values yield the caller fallback (normally empty string). The accepted JSON types here are deliberately broad because the service performs this exact coercion.

AuditedModerationPageMeta.description: v2Page does not truncate fractions; page and page_size are numbers, not guaranteed integers. total is COUNT(*); has_next is page*page_size < total.

AuditedModerationPublicUser.description: Exact v2MapPublicUser output; numeric flags remain numbers. v2DateString can preserve unparseable strings, so timestamps are not narrowed to date-time.

AuditedModerationMedia.description: Exact v2MapMedia output, including description which is missing from the older shared V2MediaAsset schema.

AuditedModerationUser.description: Exact v2ListModerationUsers mapper. is_active/is_verified are numeric database flags, not JSON booleans. status is a stored string, not an enforced API enum.

AuditedModerationStats.description: Counts across moderation tables (not the content-list filter). today_processed counts approve/reject/flag/remove/restore/ban/mute actions since database TRUNC(SYSDATE). avg_process_minutes is rounded average case duration; appeal_success_rate is rounded approved/(approved+rejected)*100; null aggregates become 0.

AuditedModerationSetting.description: value is always a string, even when value_type is number or boolean. GET returns all stored setting rows, not only the four recognized PATCH keys.

action.description: Omitted, null, object or array uses flag via v2String fallback. A supplied string must be a listed action; numbers/booleans stringify to invalid actions and produce 400.

AuditedModerationActionInput.description: JSON object required; no fields required because action defaults to flag. Unknown fields ignored. duration_hours is not read by this post action handler.

post_ids.description: v2NumberArray retains finite JSON numbers and strings convertible by Number; null, empty strings, booleans, objects, arrays and invalid numeric strings are discarded. Zero/negative values and duplicates are retained. At least one normalized id must remain or 400; each retained value is then checked for existence (404). Duplicates are processed repeatedly and counted.

action.description: Same fallback to flag as single-post action. claim/release are not accepted for bulk operations.

duration_hours.description: v2Number(value,24): finite numbers and finite numeric strings are used; other values fall back to 24 (null/boolean are not Number-coerced). No integer/positive restriction. ban <=0 means no end; mute uses max(value,1). unban/unmute/note ignore duration for restrictions but record it in the action log.

status.description: Recognized: pending, in_review, resolved, dismissed. Omitted/unknown/coerced unsupported input normalizes to pending, not 400. Only this body field is read.

appeal_status.description: Recognized approved/rejected; missing or any other value normalizes to rejected.

key.description: Only auto_hide_report_threshold, require_note_on_reject, allow_moderator_claim, default_mute_hours are updated; other keys silently ignored.

anyOf.description: Non-object entries are ignored. Array entries also have no recognized key and are ignored.
Non-array settings is treated as an empty update list.

AuditedModerationSettingsInput.description: Missing settings, empty updates or unknown keys are successful no-ops. Recognized values are stored as coerced strings without numeric/boolean validation; value_type is not updated. Response lists all stored settings.

AuditedModerationHttpError.description: Nitro 2.13.3 default JSON error transport, statically read from installed prod/dev runtime. Application v2Throw/auth errors put V2ErrorResponse inside data, not at the top level. Rate limiter uses the legacy-shaped data alternative. data may be omitted for parser/unhandled errors; stack is dev-only. Nuxt 4.4.2 requests explicitly accepting text/html can receive an HTML error page in development or production; request Accept:application/json for this transport. No runtime acceptance is asserted.

anyOf.description: Must parse using Number(value) to a finite value >0; invalid/empty values produce 400. Decimal ids are not rejected as non-integers by this helper.

target_id.description: v2RequiredNumber; required, positive and finite after normalization; string/numeric forms accepted.

target_type.description: Recognized post/comment/user/group_post/group_comment. Missing or unrecognized values normalize to post, never a target_type validation error.

reason.description: Recognized spam/harassment/hate/violence/adult/misinformation/copyright/other; missing or unsupported normalizes to other.

priority.description: Recognized low/normal/high/urgent; missing or unsupported normalizes to normal.

evidence_url.description: v2StringOrNull: coercion then an empty result becomes null. No URL format validation.

AuditedModerationCreateReportInput.description: Authenticated report submission; does not require moderation account allow-list. Unknown fields ignored. DB column lengths/constraints can still fail; no application-level string length validator is asserted.

AuditedAccountRequiredText.description: v2RequiredString converts strings/numbers/booleans to text, trims it and rejects an empty result. Clients should send strings.

otpauth_url.description: otpauth URI generated from the account and secret.

AuditedCommunityJsonValue.description: Actual permissive JSON input accepted by coercion helpers; this is not an unspecified response object. Exact per-field normalization is documented on each input property.

AuditedCommunityErrorMetadata.description: V2 metadata attached to H3 createError.data; not the top-level HTTP error body.

stack.description: Development-only framework debugging information; representation differs between Nitro/H3 handlers.

AuditedCommunityHttpError.description: Framework-generated JSON error shell. Nitro production default includes error/url/statusCode/statusMessage/message and data for handled application errors. Sensitive/unhandled failures can omit data. Development can add stack. HTML error rendering is framework/content-negotiation dependent.

AuditedCommunityRelationship.description: v2RelationObject maps raw database relation to booleans; no closed enum is enforced on relation.

AuditedCommunityPublicUser.description: Complete v2MapPublicUser output, including presence fields omitted by the older V2PublicUser schema. Numeric fields use v2Number, not an asserted integer/0-or-1 schema. last_seen_at may retain an unparseable source string; no unconditional date-time format.

AuditedCommunityMedia.description: Complete v2MapMedia output. Media type/status are emitted database strings, without serializer enum validation. created_at falls back to an empty string.

AuditedCommunityPost.description: v2MapPost reads the visible feed item via fn_can_view_post. Dates can fall back to empty strings; location is always a string even when database value is null.

AuditedCommunityNotificationPreference.description: Always present fields. GET defaults enabled=true and updated_at=current ISO time when no row; PUT uses DB timestamp converted to string or empty string.

AuditedCommunityMemberRole.description: Requested target user id and accepted role, not proof that an existing row was updated.

AuditedCommunitySentimentConfig.description: No upstream request occurs. enabled uses configured flag; baseUrlConfigured reflects non-empty normalized config, including derived localhost default, not network reachability. timeout defaults to 10000 and clamps parsed positive input to 1000..120000.

content.description: Optional; strings preserved, numbers/booleans String-converted, null/arrays/objects become empty string. Omitted leaves existing content. No handler max length.

visibility.description: Optional exact case-sensitive enum. Omitted leaves current visibility.

language.description: Optional. v2String then trim/lowercase; empty defaults to zh. Non-empty normalized value must match /^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z0-9]{2,7})?$/; output limited to 10 characters.

location.description: Optional. v2String conversion; empty/null/non-scalar becomes database null, returned serializer emits empty string. Omitted unchanged.

media_ids.description: Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers or numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Deduplicate and keep first four; each must belong to caller and status uploaded/processing/ready. No rejection solely for >4 inputs.

tag_names.description: Optional replacement. Array items v2String-convert and trim, empty filtered; non-array becomes []. Strip one leading # then trim, deduplicate, first twenty retained.

mention_user_ids.description: Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers/numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Unique first fifty processed; missing users silently ignored.

mediaIds.description: Camel-case alias; ignored whenever snake-case media_ids is present, including null. Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers or numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Deduplicate and keep first four; each must belong to caller and status uploaded/processing/ready. No rejection solely for >4 inputs.

tagNames.description: Camel-case alias; ignored whenever snake-case tag_names is present, including null. Optional replacement. Array items v2String-convert and trim, empty filtered; non-array becomes []. Strip one leading # then trim, deduplicate, first twenty retained.

mentionUserIds.description: Camel-case alias; ignored whenever snake-case mention_user_ids is present, including null. Optional replacement. Array items convert finite numbers/numeric strings; null/empty/unconvertible filtered; non-array becomes []. Unique first fifty processed; missing users silently ignored.

is_enabled.description: Optional, defaults false when absent. true boolean, number exactly 1, or case-insensitive strings 1/true/yes map to true; all other JSON values map false. Strings are not trimmed. Examples: true, 1, "YES".
